sections.title: Körül: around
sections.content: *Körül* means "around" and works like the other place words: *A kert a ház körül van.* (The garden is around the house.) It follows the noun, and the noun stays unchanged.

sections.title: Asking where
sections.content: Ask with *Hol van …?* (Where is …?) and answer with a place phrase: *Hol van a macska? – A kapu előtt van.* You can drop *van* in the short answer: *A kapu előtt.* To ask where someone is going, use *Hová?*; for where something is, use *Hol?*.

items.spanish: A kert a ház körül van.
items.english: The garden is around the house.
It is in front of the gate.

items.spanish: Az udvar a ház mögött van.
items.english: The yard is behind the house.

sections.content: Use *Hol?* for where something is and *Hová?* for where it is going. *Hol van a macska?* asks about a place; *Hová megy a macska?* asks about a movement.
